scripts.community-events:site:setup: npm run community-events:env -- run cli wp plugin activate wporg-community-events && npm run community-events:env -- run cli wp theme activate wporg-events && npm run community-events:env -- run cli wp eval 'require WP_CONTENT_DIR . "/themes/wporg-events/bin/seed.php";'
scripts.community-events:test:setup: npm run community-events:env -- run tests-cli composer require --dev phpunit/phpunit:^9.6 yoast/phpunit-polyfills:^2.0 --working-dir=/wordpress-phpunit --with-all-dependencies
scripts.community-events:test: npm run community-events:env -- run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/wporg-community-events sh -c 'find tests -name "class-*-test.php" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 /wordpress-phpunit/vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist'
scripts.plugins:import: npm run plugins:env -- run cli -- php wp-content/plugins/plugin-directory/bin/import-plugin.php --create --plugin
scripts.plugins:refresh: npm run plugins:env -- run cli -- wp option delete wporg_env_imported && npm run plugins:env -- run cli wp eval-file wp-content/env-bin/import-plugins.php
